data.notes: January 2027 is already anchored by New Year’s Day dance festivals, a strong Carriageworks/club run, diaspora parties, and several major touring concerts.

events.title: Field Day 2027
events.summary: Field Day returns to The Domain on New Year’s Day with a dance/electronic lineup led by Major Lazer and Sub Focus, plus Andy C, Boys Noize, Elderbrook, Hannah Laing, Oppidan and others.

events.title: Yabun Festival 2027
events.summary: Yabun returns on 26 January as a major First Nations cultural gathering with traditional and contemporary music, dance, talks, workshops, markets and community programming.

events.title: Dangerous Goods XXL Festival - Sydney 2027
events.summary: Dangerous Goods XXL brings a multi-stage techno, hardstyle, psytrance and trance bill to Sydney Showgrounds with Boris Brejcha, Claptone, Darude, Neelix, Sub Zero Project and Anderex among the Phase 1 lineup.

events.title: Hellbound 2 Cruise 2027
events.venueName: Carnival Splendor / Overseas Passenger Terminal Sydney
events.summary: Hellbound 2 is a four-night heavy music cruise departing Sydney for Tangalooma and returning to Sydney, featuring Parkway Drive, The Amity Affliction, Thy Art Is Murder, Alpha Wolf, Ocean Grove, RedHook and more.

events.title: Vince Staples
events.summary: Vince Staples plays Enmore Theatre as part of his Australian headline run, marking his first Australian shows since 2018.

events.title: THE WORKS [JAN 8] feat. Overmono
events.summary: UK duo Overmono bring their breakbeat, dub and club-led live sound to Carriageworks for THE WORKS.

events.title: Bryson Tiller - The Neo Trapsoul Tour
events.summary: Bryson Tiller brings The Neo Trapsoul Tour to Afterpay Arena with Majid Jordan listed as support on the Australian dates.

events.title: SUMMER DANCE x Rinse FM - SYD - Liberty Hall Courts
events.summary: Astral People, Summer Dance and Rinse FM present an open-air Liberty Hall Courts takeover led by JME, Yung Singh, Mia Koden, Prozak, Surusinghe and more.

events.title: Nia Archives
events.summary: Nia Archives’ official tour page lists a Sydney date at Metro Theatre following Australian summer festival appearances, bringing her jungle and electronic sound to the city.

events.title: THE WORKS [JAN 7] feat. Sam Alfred b2b Job Jobse
events.summary: Sam Alfred and Job Jobse play a special back-to-back warehouse session at Carriageworks for THE WORKS.

events.title: THE WORKS [JAN 9] feat. KI/KI
events.summary: Amsterdam techno/trance selector KI/KI headlines THE WORKS at Carriageworks Bay 22–24.

events.title: The Human League - Generations Greatest Hits Tour
events.summary: The Human League play two Enmore Theatre shows on their Generations greatest-hits tour, revisiting four decades of synth-pop material.

events.title: Tyler ICU Live Sydney
events.summary: South African amapiano producer Tyler ICU headlines a Sydney club night billed with hip-hop, R&B, Afrobeats, Amapiano, UK hip-hop and French Afro selections.

events.title: THE WORKS [JAN 6] feat. Rossi., Dean Turnley b2b Jamback
events.summary: Finely Tuned’s THE WORKS series opens with Rossi., Dean Turnley b2b Jamback and Stacie Fields at Carriageworks, focused on low-slung house and warehouse-scale club music.

events.title: SWIM - AU Tour (Live with Orchestra)
events.summary: Melbourne-born, London-based artist SWIM brings an immersive live house show with a full orchestra to Carriageworks.

events.title: House CLTR Sydney - XXXL NYD Boat Party
events.summary: House CLTR’s New Year’s Day sunset cruise bills three secret UK international headliners, five hours of house and deep-house classics, and a 25+ no-phones dancefloor on Sydney Harbour.

events.title: RUN THE NUMBERS ft. 4AM KRU [UK]
events.summary: Run The Numbers presents 4AM KRU at Oxford Art Factory with Irene J, Swisherman, Ninyo and Fashionably Late on support.

events.title: Beach Bar 2027 | Caribbean Rooftop Pool Party
events.venueName: The Rooftop Pool at The Old Clare Hotel
events.summary: Caribbean Sydney and Prescription Caribbean Club bring back Beach Bar for its 12th edition: a rooftop pool party centred on soca, dancehall, Afrobeats and bouyon with DJ Fasmwa, Nicole Tania and Koolbreeze.

events.title: Great Southern Sounds
events.summary: Six-night Australian music cruise departing Sydney, led by Jimmy Barnes, Jon Stevens, Kate Ceberano, Daryl Braithwaite, Lee Kernaghan, Kasey Chambers, Troy Cassar-Daley and Marcia Hines among 35+ onboard acts.

events.title: Beartooth – Pure Ecstasy Australia Tour
events.summary: Beartooth play Hordern Pavilion on their Pure Ecstasy Australia Tour, with Fit For A King and Volumes confirmed as special guests.

events.title: Public Image Ltd – This Is Not The Last Tour
events.summary: John Lydon’s Public Image Ltd bring their Australasia tour to The Enmore, the Sydney stop on a run that also includes Brisbane, Melbourne, Adelaide and Perth.

events.title: Yeah Buoy - New Years Sunrise Boat Party
events.venueName: King Street Wharf / Inception, Sydney Harbour
events.summary: New Year’s Day sunrise harbour afterparty from Yeah Buoy, billed as a 3-level, 2-stage, 400+ capacity house-and-tech cruise running 3am–7am.

events.title: Waylon Wyatt – Dustpiles World Tour
events.summary: Rising US folk-country artist Waylon Wyatt plays Enmore Theatre on the Australian leg of the Dustpiles World Tour, joined by special guest Clover County.

events.title: The Island Sydney: New Years Eve
events.venueName: The Island Sydney / Elizabeth Bay Marina
events.summary: The Island’s harbourside NYE party crosses into 1 January 2027, pairing premium waterfront fireworks access with a DJ-led island-club format.

events.title: Trance Day Party: Sydney
events.summary: Daytime Disco Australia brings its daytime rave format to Potts Point for an afternoon of trance anthems and festival-style electronic classics.

events.title: The Cliff Dive Fridays
events.summary: Weekly Oxford Street basement night running across Fridays in January with resident DJs, MCs and performers focused on hip-hop and R&B, with No Diggity-style club energy flagged by the venue listing.
